# fast boot (test only): Vice, a match of goals, each with its celebration and replay

# ---- the fast boot is switched on by the route's first line (`bootmatch 13:3:6 ...`): in the emulator the Vita build's env file did not deliver MSC_BOOT_MATCH ----
